resources.string: Import from Yuzu Browser
Select an exported backup. Choose the data to merge before importing.

In Yuzu Browser, open Settings → Import/Export. Export a settings backup (.yuzubackup), bookmarks (.dat or HTML), and speed dial separately (.yuzudial). Current Citrus exports and standalone settings XML are also accepted.

Select settings, button actions, search providers, user agents, site rules, built-in light/dark themes, bookmarks, speed dial, user scripts and gestures. Matching supported keys/actions overwrite current values; other configuration keeps existing items. Bookmarks go into a new folder; matching speed dial URLs are kept.

External theme assets are absent from the old backup, so your current theme is kept. History, downloads, storage grants, unknown databases/caches and Java binary data are excluded. Internal actions with an unselected dependency are skipped. Select scripts only from exports you trust.

Ordinary save failures attempt to restore the previous values. Changes across databases and files are not fully atomic across power loss or forced process termination. Keep the original export. No other app private storage is accessed.
